idea-plugin.name: SchemaSmith - Entity Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Generate JPA entity classes from SQL DDL, a .sql file, or a live database connection.

Included:

  • Paste a CREATE TABLE statement directly
  • Generate from a .sql file
  • Connect directly to a live database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, H2) and generate from selected tables

Generated entities use Lombok (@Getter, @Setter, @NoArgsConstructor, @AllArgsConstructor, @Builder/@SuperBuilder) instead of hand-written boilerplate, support composite primary keys via @EmbeddedId, and turn foreign keys into real @ManyToOne/@OneToMany relationships when both sides are generated together.
